statement: Written before the DEMETER2 combined RNAi data were downloaded or viewed by this project.
known_before_writing: The lead (ATP6V0E2 loss -> ATP6V0E1) was found to be already published (Dempster et al. 2019, Nat Commun, Fig. 3e). This test asks whether it, and the other pairs, hold under a different perturbation technology, not whether they are new.

rules.data: DEMETER2 combined RNAi gene_effect.csv (Achilles + DRIVE + Marcotte; Figshare record 9170975 v1), cell lines indexed by DepMap ModelID. More negative = more dependent.
rules.lines_primary: All RNAi-screened models with a gene effect for the target and a biomarker call.
rules.lines_secondary: The same, excluding models in this project's 24Q4 DISCOVERY split (new cell lines AND new technology). Reported separately.
rules.biomarkers: Same definitions as before, computed from the 26Q3 omics files already downloaded (default entry per model).
rules.test: Same lineage-adjusted one-sided test as prospective.py; replicated if p < 0.01 and beta < 0; untestable if < 3 altered or unaltered lines; BH 5% across testable pairs; sign test on lead+candidates; control replication rate = power.

predictions.lead: Replicates if testable (it is a published dependency; RNAi off-target noise could still hide it).
predictions.general: RNAi is noisier than CRISPR (seed-driven off-target effects), so fewer controls and candidates replicate than in CRISPR; direction should still mostly agree.
